name: 123,000 BCE - Eemian Interglacial & Early Humans
description: Eemian interglacial period; early anatomically modern humans and Neanderthal hunter-gatherer ranges.

name: 10,000 BCE - Dawn of the Holocene
description: End of the Last Glacial Period; emergence of early agriculture and sedentary hunter-gatherer communities in the Fertile Crescent.

name: 8000 BCE - Early Neolithic Era
description: Early agricultural settlements expand across the Near East, Anatolia (Göbekli Tepe, Çatalhöyük), and East Asia.

name: 5000 BCE - Chalcolithic & Ubaid Period
description: Ubaid period in Mesopotamia, early farming cultures in the Nile Valley, Yangshao culture in China, and Vinča culture in Europe.

name: 4000 BCE - Early Bronze Age & Urban Genesis
description: First cities arise in Sumer (Uruk period); predynastic Egypt and Kurgan cultures spread across the Eurasian steppe.

name: 3000 BCE - Early Dynastic & Sumerian Cities
description: Unification of Egypt under the First Dynasty, Sumerian Early Dynastic city-states, and the rise of the Indus Valley Civilization.

name: 2000 BCE - Middle Bronze Age & Minoan Crete
description: Middle Kingdom Egypt, Ur III Sumerian Renaissance, Minoan civilization in Crete, and Xia/Erlitou China.

name: 1500 BCE - Late Bronze Age Empires
description: New Kingdom Egyptian Empire, Hittite Empire in Anatolia, Mycenaean Greece, and Shang Dynasty in China.

name: 1000 BCE - Early Iron Age
description: Bronze Age collapse aftermath, Kingdom of Israel under David & Solomon, early Western Zhou Dynasty in China.

name: 700 BCE - Neo-Assyrian Empire & Archaic Greece
description: Neo-Assyrian Empire at its peak; Spring and Autumn period in China; rise of Archaic Greek poleis and Nubian 25th Dynasty.

name: 500 BCE - Classical Antiquity & Persian Zenith
description: Achaemenid Persian Empire at its zenith, Golden Age of Classical Greece, and early Roman Republic.

name: 400 BCE - Late Classical & Warring States
description: Peloponnesian War aftermath in Greece; Warring States era in China; Mahajanapadas and rise of Magadha in India.

name: 323 BCE - Hellenistic Kingdoms & Alexander
description: Death of Alexander the Great and division of his empire into Diadochi kingdoms (Ptolemaic, Seleucid, Antigonid); Mauryan expansion.

name: 300 BCE - Mauryan Empire & Hellenistic World
description: Mauryan Empire under Chandragupta Maurya and Ashoka dominates South Asia; Qin state prepares for Chinese unification.

name: 200 BCE - Han & Roman Expansion
description: Western Han Dynasty consolidates China, Roman Republic defeats Carthage in the Second Punic War.

name: 100 BCE - Late Roman Republic & Han Silk Road
description: Late Roman Republic under Marius and Sulla; Han Dynasty expands the Silk Road through Central Asia under Emperor Wu.

name: 1 BCE - Augustan Roman Empire
description: Pax Romana begins under Emperor Augustus; Han Dynasty China and Parthian Empire dominate Eurasia.

name: 100 CE - Trajan & High Roman Empire
description: Roman Empire reaches maximum territorial extent under Trajan; Eastern Han Dynasty and Kushan Empire thrive.

name: 200 CE - Severan Rome & Three Kingdoms Prelude
description: Severan dynasty in Rome; collapse of the Han Dynasty leading to the Three Kingdoms era in China; Sasanian rise in Persia.

name: 300 CE - Tetrarchy & Gupta Foundation
description: Diocletian's Tetrarchy reorganizes Rome; Gupta Empire founded in India; Jin Dynasty in China.

name: 400 CE - Late Antiquity & Migrations
description: Western Roman Empire collapses amidst barbarian migrations; Eastern Roman (Byzantine), Sasanian, and Gupta empires flourish.

name: 500 CE - Post-Roman Kingdoms & Northern/Southern Dynasties
description: Ostrogothic, Visigothic, and Frankish kingdoms divide Western Europe; Byzantine Empire under Anastasius I; Northern & Southern dynasties in China.

name: 600 CE - Early Middle Ages & Sui Unification
description: Byzantine-Sasanian wars on the eve of the Islamic expansion; Sui dynasty reunifies China followed by early Tang.

name: 700 CE - Umayyad Caliphate & Tang Golden Age
description: Umayyad Caliphate expands from Spain to the Indus Valley; Tang Dynasty China reaches cultural height under Empress Wu Zetian.

name: 800 CE - Carolingian & Abbasid Golden Age
description: Charlemagne crowned Emperor of the Romans; Abbasid Caliphate Golden Age in Baghdad; Tang Dynasty in China.

name: 900 CE - Five Dynasties & Norse Expansion
description: Viking expansions in Europe; collapse of Tang China into the Five Dynasties; rise of the Samanids and Fatimids.

name: 1000 CE - High Middle Ages & Song Dynasty
description: Song Dynasty China, Holy Roman Empire under the Ottonians, Fatimid Caliphate, and Byzantine Empire under Basil II.

name: 1100 CE - Crusader States & Great Seljuks
description: Establishment of Crusader States after the First Crusade; Great Seljuk Empire dominates the Middle East; Liao and Northern Song in China.

name: 1200 CE - Eve of the Mongol Invasions
description: Ayyubid Sultanate under Saladin's successors; Jin and Southern Song in China; Genghis Khan prepares to unify the Mongol tribes.

name: 1279 CE - Mongol Empire & Yuan Dynasty
description: Kublai Khan conquers the Song Dynasty establishing the Yuan Dynasty; Pax Mongolica spans Eurasia.

name: 1300 CE - Four Mongol Khanates & Ottoman Genesis
description: Division of Mongol Empire into Yuan, Ilkhanate, Chagatai, and Golden Horde; foundation of Ottoman principality by Osman I.

name: 1400 CE - Timurid Empire & Early Ming
description: Conquests of Timur (Tamerlane) across Central Asia and Middle East; Ming Dynasty consolidates China and launches treasure voyages.

name: 1492 CE - Age of Discovery
description: Columbus reaches the Americas; Spanish Reconquista completed; Ming Dynasty China and Ottoman Empire expand.

name: 1500 CE - Global Maritime Networks
description: Portuguese establish sea route to India (Vasco da Gama) and Brazil (Cabral); Safavid dynasty founded in Iran.

name: 1530 CE - Reformation & Global Empires
description: Charles V rules Habsburg global empire; Protestant Reformation; Mughal Empire established in India by Babur.

name: 1600 CE - Tokugawa Shogunate & East India Companies
description: Battle of Sekigahara establishes Tokugawa Shogunate in Japan; English and Dutch East India Companies chartered; Akbar expands Mughal Empire.

name: 1650 CE - Peace of Westphalia
description: End of Thirty Years' War establishes modern nation-state sovereignty; Qing Dynasty conquers Ming China.

name: 1700 CE - Great Northern War & War of Spanish Succession
description: Outbreak of the Great Northern War in the Baltic and War of the Spanish Succession; Peter the Great modernizes Russia.

name: 1715 CE - Age of Enlightenment
description: End of War of the Spanish Succession and death of Louis XIV; rise of Great Britain, Prussia, and Russian Empire under Peter the Great.

name: 1783 CE - American Independence
description: Treaty of Paris recognizes the United States; Pre-Revolutionary France; Catherine the Great expands Russia into Crimea.

name: 1800 CE - Napoleonic Era & Global Shifts
description: Rise of Napoleon in Europe; United States expands; Qing Dynasty at peak geographic extent; British East India Company expands across India.

name: 1815 CE - Congress of Vienna
description: Post-Napoleonic Concert of Europe; Latin American wars of independence create new republics.

name: 1878 CE - Congress of Berlin & Eve of the War of the Pacific
description: Congress of Berlin restructures the Balkans; eve of the War of the Pacific in South America; Late Victorian imperial era.

name: 1880 CE - High Imperialism
description: Scramble for Africa begins; newly unified Germany and Italy; Victorian British Empire at global peak.

name: 1900 CE - Turn of the Century
description: Boxer Rebellion in China; Boer War in South Africa; global imperial powers at maximum territorial extent.

name: 1914 CE - Outbreak of World War I
description: Eurasia on the eve of WWI; European alliances, Austro-Hungarian, Russian, and Ottoman Empires before their collapse.

name: 1920 CE - Interwar & League of Nations
description: Post-WWI border restructuring under Treaty of Versailles; emergence of Poland, Czechoslovakia, Yugoslavia, and Soviet Union.

name: 1930 CE - Great Depression & Rising Autocracies
description: Global economic crisis of the Great Depression; Weimar Republic crisis; Japanese expansion in Manchuria.

name: 1938 CE - Eve of World War II
description: Pre-WWII Europe following Austrian Anschluss; Second Sino-Japanese War; Axis and Allied powers aligning.

name: 1945 CE - Post-World War II
description: Post-WWII division of Germany and Europe; founding of the United Nations; dawn of the Cold War and Asian decolonization.

name: 1960 CE - Year of Africa & Cold War Zenith
description: Wave of African independence (Year of Africa); Space Race and Cold War nuclear standoff between NATO and Warsaw Pact.

name: 1994 CE - Post-Cold War World
description: Dissolution of Soviet Union and Yugoslavia; establishment of the European Union (Maastricht); post-Apartheid South Africa.

name: 2000 CE - Turn of the Millennium
description: Dawn of the 21st century; expanding European Union; rise of global internet economy and WTO integration.

name: 2010 CE - Contemporary Era
description: Globalized modern world; Arab Spring prelude; contemporary geopolitical alignments and sovereign states.
